name: mmo-market
description: Sàn giao dịch sản phẩm MMO: nhiều gian hàng, ký quỹ, chợ yêu cầu, chat, admin

scripts.infra:up: docker compose up -d postgres redis mailpit
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web,admin -c blue,green,magenta "npm run dev -w @mmo/api" "npm run dev -w @mmo/web" "npm run dev -w @mmo/admin"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @mmo/api && npm run build -w @mmo/web && npm run build -w @mmo/admin
scripts.start: concurrently -k -n api,web,admin -c blue,green,magenta "npm run start -w @mmo/api" "npm run start -w @mmo/web" "npm run start -w @mmo/admin"
